title: polyscias collina
intro: Polyscias collina, commonly known as the Elephant Ear or Mountain Polyscias, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Africa and Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Polyscias collina include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Polyscias collina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
